notes:
- Every gun has its own Tier III name and effect: Hellfire Judge (blast and burn), Hornet Queen (hits
  bounce to 2 more), Dragon's Breath (sets them alight), Widowmaker's Kiss (headshots burst in shrapnel),
  Grinder Prime (every 8th hit explodes), Judgement Day (lightning strikes), Tempest Sovereign (chains to 4),
  Shatterpoint (freezes; frozen kills shatter), Bloodline (kills refill the mag and heal), Trinity Storm,
  Twin Dragons, Doomsday Bloom (cluster bombs), Reaper's Harvest, Sentinel's Mark, Deadeye Supernova,
  Swarm Mother, Inferno Annihilator, Starfall Requiem (seeking shards) and Sir Chonk's Last Laugh (stuns).
- New melee weapon: Excalibur. Tier III, Light of Avalon: hits consecrate the ground, healing players
  in it and burning zombies.
- Melee weapons come from the Mystery Box now (no more wall buys), and they're toned down: they
  one-shot everything far too late into a game.
- Tier III katana: a three-strike combo ending in a spinning slash and three blade waves. Tier III
  melee weapons have their own names too.
- Compass at the top of the screen: bearings, the perk machines in rooms you've opened, and your
  teammates with their distance.
- Ice King/Queen grenades are a spell: a frost orb charged in your hand and cast with a palm thrust.
- Weapon prestige camos: Forged Bronze (P1), Obsidian Silver (P2), Moonforged Silver (P3), Obsidian
  Gold (P4) and Sunforged Gold (P5), all animated, with particle auras.
- Max level is now 100 (XP per level stops growing at 12,000), with new ranks. Guns and melee weapons
  unlock for customizing over levels 1-72. An account prestige now needs level 100.
- Teammate outlines and the last zombies' glow only show through walls, not in plain view.
- Sir Chonk spawns on the real ground with room for his size (he came out inside a hill once).
- The Alpha and Warden Cole never turn up during a Le Chonk round; they wait for the next normal one.
